description: This file implements debugging functionalities for OpenGL and EGL within the ANGLE project, including message logging, message filtering, group management, and callback handling.

classes.name: Debug::Control
classes.description: Represents message control settings for filtering debug messages.

classes.name: Debug::Group
classes.description: Represents a group of debug messages with associated controls.

classes.name: Debug
classes.description: Main class managing debug message logging, filtering, and callbacks for OpenGL and EGL.

methods.name: Debug::setMaxLoggedMessages
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of messages to log.

methods.name: Debug::setOutputEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables debug output.

methods.name: Debug::isOutputEnabled
methods.description: Checks if debug output is enabled.

methods.name: Debug::setOutputSynchronous
methods.description: Sets whether output is synchronous.

methods.name: Debug::isOutputSynchronous
methods.description: Checks if output is synchronous.

methods.name: Debug::setCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback function for debug messages.

methods.name: Debug::getCallback
methods.description: Returns the current callback function.

methods.name: Debug::getUserParam
methods.description: Returns the user parameter associated with the callback.

methods.name: Debug::insertMessage
methods.description: Inserts a debug message with specified parameters.

methods.name: Debug::getMessages
methods.description: Retrieves stored debug messages.

methods.name: Debug::getNextMessageLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the next message.

methods.name: Debug::getMessageCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of stored messages.

methods.name: Debug::setMessageControl
methods.description: Sets message filtering controls.

methods.name: Debug::pushGroup
methods.description: Pushes a new debug message group onto the stack.

methods.name: Debug::popGroup
methods.description: Pops the current debug message group.

methods.name: Debug::getGroupStackDepth
methods.description: Returns the current depth of the group stack.

methods.name: Debug::isMessageEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a message with specific source, type, id, and severity is enabled.

methods.name: Debug::pushDefaultGroup
methods.description: Pushes the default message group.

methods.name: egl::Debug::setCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback for EGL debug messages.

methods.name: egl::Debug::getCallback
methods.description: Returns the current EGL debug callback.

methods.name: egl::Debug::isMessageTypeEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific EGL message type is enabled.

methods.name: egl::Debug::insertMessage
methods.description: Inserts an EGL debug message.
